accepted.sentence: Pistons may be made from nickel-plated brass or corrosion-resistant alloys such as Monel, chosen to withstand repeated movement.
Some versions use rotary valves, whose lever-operated cylinders turn to redirect airflow instead of moving vertically.
Piccolo models often add a fourth valve, which extends the playable range downward by roughly a perfect fourth.
A tapered receiver at the leadpipe's end holds the mouthpiece securely through a snug friction fit.
Some models use a first-slide trigger, letting the player make quick adjustments to correct the pitch of low notes.
A guide on each piston keeps its air ports aligned with the casing's passages as the button moves.
Nested inner and outer slide tubes fit closely together while allowing the movable sections to extend and retract.
Some models have a one-piece bell formed from a single metal blank rather than from joined bell sections.
